products.name: Classic NYC Thicc Choc Chip
products.tagline: 160g of pure serotonin, gooey center with 70% dark Belgian chocolate
products.description: Our viral signature cookie. Golden, crisp exterior with a warm molten center packed with double Belgian chocolate chunks and sprinkled with Maldon sea salt flakes. Heat for 15s in the microwave and prepare to see God.
products.ingredientsSnippet: Stone-ground flour, pasture butter, Belgian 70% chocolate, brown sugar, organic eggs, Maldon salt

products.name: Lotus Biscoff Molten Cookie
products.tagline: Stuffed with molten Biscoff spread and topped with caramelized lotus crumb
products.description: She is that girl. Rich spiced brown butter cookie dough injected with a generous tablespoon of creamy Biscoff spread, crowned with a crunchy Speculoos biscuit. Zero regrets, 100% main character energy.
products.ingredientsSnippet: Brown butter, Belgian flour, Lotus Speculoos cream, vanilla bean paste, brown sugar

products.name: The Mzansi Milk Tart Cookie
products.tagline: Cinnamon spiced velvet custard encased in a golden buttery biscuit
products.description: A love letter to South Africa. Traditional melktert reimagined as an artisan cookie. A crumbly, rich butter biscuit base cupping a silky cooked cinnamon & nutmeg custard core. Lekker doesn’t even begin to cover it.
products.ingredientsSnippet: Real milk tart custard, pure Ceylon cinnamon, nutmeg, butter shortcrust

products.name: Hertzoggie Apricot Blondie
products.tagline: Toasted coconut meringue cloud, tangy apricot jam, brown butter dough
products.description: Your Ouma could never (respectfully). Fudgy brown sugar blondie base with a generous swirl of home-made Robertson apricot preserve, topped with a crisp, toasted golden coconut meringue cap.
products.ingredientsSnippet: Toasted desiccated coconut, free-range egg white meringue, apricot preserve, brown butter

products.name: Savage Message Biscuits (Pack of 4)
products.tagline: Hand-stamped butter cookies with your custom petty or sweet message
products.description: Say it with carbs. 4 thick, pastel pink vanilla sugar biscuits with crisp royal icing and your custom stamped text. Great for birthdays, breakups, promotions, or reminding your bestie she’s that girl.
products.customPlaceholder: e.g. DUMP HIM / IT’S GIVING BIRTHDAY / CERTIFIED BABE
products.ingredientsSnippet: Madagascar vanilla bean, organic flour, butter, lemon-infused sugar fondant

products.name: Midnight Nutella Lava Bomb
products.tagline: Double dark cocoa dough with an oozing molten hazelnut core
products.description: Warning: High risk of eating this in the dark in your pyjamas. Extra dark Dutch cocoa dough packed with roasted hazelnuts and stuffed with liquid Nutella that pours out when warm.
products.ingredientsSnippet: Dutch black cocoa, Ferrero hazelnut cream, semi-sweet Belgian callets

products.name: The Plug Box (Best Seller 6-Pack)
products.tagline: The ultimate sampler box packed in signature hot pink with ribbons
products.description: Cannot decide? We got you. Contains: 2x Classic NYC Choc, 1x Biscoff Molten, 1x Mzansi Milk Tart, 1x Nutella Lava, 1x Red Velvet Cream Cheese. Comes in our keepsake pink bakery box with stickers and handwritten note.
products.ingredientsSnippet: Full assortment of our top fresh-baked goodies

products.name: Red Velvet Cheesecake Core
products.tagline: Ruby cocoa cookie with a tangy vanilla bean cream cheese centre
products.description: Velvety, soft-baked red cocoa dough enveloping a chilled, tangy cream cheese core. Topped with white chocolate drizzle. It is giving high society tea party in Houghton.
products.ingredientsSnippet: Red velvet dough, Philadelphia cream cheese, Madagascar vanilla, Belgian white chips

products.name: Campfire S’mores Brownie Slab
products.tagline: Dense fudge brownie, toasted golden marshmallow, biscuit crumb
products.description: Crispy edges, ridiculously fudgy center, melted Hershey-style chocolate shards, and real blow-torched campfire marshmallows that stretch for days.
products.ingredientsSnippet: Valrhona cocoa powder, 70% dark chocolate, toasted gelatin-free marshmallows
